captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, rectangular keychain base with a rounded end featuring a circular hole for a keyring. The main body is a long, thin stick with a uniform rectangular cross-section. At one end, it smoothly transitions into a semi-circular profile concentric with the vertical cylindrical hole.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric keychain base in OpenSCAD that features a flat supporting stick and an integrated keyring hole on one end. The script should allow the user to adjust the length of the stick based on text length, the stick width, stick thickness, and the hole radius, with an option to align the stick flat with the bottom of the text.
captions.factory: The script defines a module 'flatstickwithhole' which uses a union of a centered cube for the stick body and a cylinder at one end to form the rounded loop. A difference operation subtracts a smaller cylinder from the rounded end to create the keyring hole. The main body combines this stick with extruded text generated from the 'write' library, adjusting the vertical translation of the stick based on the 'flat_bottom' parameter.
